title: EHBP conformance fixture
description: One language-neutral test case. The harness feeds `operation` + `inputs` (and, for e2e, `server_scenario` + `request`) to every adapter and asserts the returned normalized result matches `expect`.

category.description: crypto/config run in-process against the library API; e2e runs over HTTP against the oracle server.

operation.description: The standard operation the adapter performs. `request` is the only e2e operation; the rest are in-process.

inputs.description: Operation inputs. Byte fields are lowercase hex. Which keys apply depends on `operation`; see conformance/spec for the per-operation contract. Examples: derive_keys -> {exportedSecret, requestEnc, responseNonce}; decrypt_response -> {..., encryptedResponse}; compute_nonce -> {nonceBase, seq}; token_parse -> {json}; parse_config -> {config}; marshal_config -> {publicKey}.

chunking.description: For streaming decrypt fixtures: byte offsets at which to split the encrypted input before feeding it, to prove fragmentation handling. Optional.

server_scenario.description: e2e only. Named route/behavior on the oracle server, e.g. 'echo', 'drop_nonce_200', 'drop_nonce_502', 'invalid_nonce_len', 'duplicate_nonce', 'key_config_mismatch_422', 'truncate_final_frame', 'oversized_chunk', 'tamper_tag', 'plaintext_passthrough'.

request.description: e2e only. The request the adapter issues through the library's public client API.

browser.description: Whether this fixture is observable in browser mode. 'na' fixtures are reported skipped (with skip_reason) rather than run, per anti-concealment requirement 5.

expect.description: The normalized result every conforming language must produce. A subset of the result schema's asserted fields; the harness compares only the keys present here plus the always-asserted outcome/error_code.

response_headers_absent.description: Header names (lowercase) that MUST NOT be present on the delivered response, e.g. content-length, transfer-encoding after decrypt.

response_headers_present.description: Header names (lowercase) that MUST be present.
